weapons.name: Training Broadblade
weapons.passiveDesc: Increases Elemental Mastery by 80 for 12s after using an Elemental Burst. Can be triggered once every 30s.

weapons.name: Training Sword
weapons.passiveDesc: ATK is increased by 20%. Triggers on taking DMG: the soul of the Falcon of the West awakens, holding the banner of resistance aloft, regenerating HP equal to 100% of ATK and dealing DMG equal to 200% of ATK to surrounding enemies. Lasts for 15s and can only occur once every 60s.

weapons.name: Stellar Symphony
weapons.passiveDesc: Increase HP by 12%. Restore 8 Concerto Energy when casting Resonance Liberation. This effect can be triggered 1 time(s) every 20s. When casting Resonance Skill that heals, increase nearby party member's ATK by 14% for 30s. Effects of the same name cannot be stacked.
